notes.title: New upcoming game - Breeding Visa
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/ad1afbcfa106fb1660df1553ca668f000b3c7d9a.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3785660/Breeding_Visa/

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/3f2fe354a1fbd398640e2f71b3a848cd1c15027a.png[/img]

[h1]Sex. Sex is always needed.[/h1]

A nation once known for its traditions and technological marvels thrived, its cities buzzing with life and its streets filled with busy crowds. Bullet trains sliced through misty mountains, neon-lit cities hummed with robotic servers, and engineers built AI companions fluent in a dozen languages.

But sex is always needed.

Over decades, people stopped connecting. Romance faded into memory. Dating apps shut down. Birth rates flatlined. Sex became a rumour, a half-remembered chore from a bygone era. By the year 2042, the silence grew deafening: an entire generation had forgotten how to want, how to touch, how to fuck. The government's answer was as radical as it was crude. The [i][b]Breeding Visa[/b] Program[/i]: a last-ditch program inviting foreign men to step into the void. No one pretended it was elegant. Locals weren't lining up for romance - they'd buried that instinct years ago. The task fell to outsiders: penetrate the apathy, spark desire where none existed, and plant the seeds of survival.

You are part of this awkward experiment. Your qualifications? A pulse, working anatomy, and the patience to teach what's been erased. The women here aren't shy. They're oblivious. Flirting? Foreplay? The missionary position? Lost knowledge, like hieroglyphics. Your job isn't just to fuck - it's to reboot a cultural libido from scratch. It won't be pretty. Expect blank stares when you unzip. Confusion over where things go. Women who'd rather binge streaming dramas than grind against a stranger. But the government's counting on you. Incentives are offered. And beneath the awkwardness? A flicker of curiosity. Maybe even hunger. The clock's ticking. Seduce a society that's forgotten how to feel. Or watch a civilisation fade into virginity.

Your life is about to change.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/ded825268af44a35b9c48a63ca065f42df056ca5.png[/img]

[h1]You Are the Catalyst[/h1]

Armed with a controversial past and an assertive personality, you’ll pursue reluctant women across a society obsessed with work and devoid of passion. Break through their apathy using any means necessary, persuasion, manipulation, or sheer dominance. Your visa depends on results.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/1adc528b9aef5d641ce7e43f21629d30b074904b.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay Experience[/h1]

[i]Breeding Visa[/i] delivers a classic choice-driven visual novel with deep narrative branching

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44772350/87b7403f87bd187a6d423c3b713ecb03a9b80684.png[/img]

[h1]Key Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [u][b]Seduction[/b][/u]: Target distinct women like the icy bureaucrat Yumiko, the rigid landlady Sakura, the anxious clerk Ami, and the hostile lifeguard Rin. Overcome their unique hangups through dialogue choices and escalating encounters.

[*] [u][b]Explicit Consequences[/b][/u]: Your choices lead to graphic scenes of exhibitionism, steamy encounters, and raw sex.

[*] [u][b]Save or Doom a Nation[/b][/u]: Your success determines this nation's survival. Will you spark a sexual revolution or watch civilisation fade into sterile oblivion?

[*] [u][b]Branching Paths[/b][/u]: Virginity, pregnancy, or societal collapse hinge on your strategy.

[*] [u][b]Uncompromising Adult Content[/b][/u]: Features uncensored sex, nudity, and adult themes.
[/list]

notes.title: Fifth content update + endings released
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce the release of the fifth content update for Forbidden Dojo.

This update concludes the story of Forbidden Dojo. There are five different endings that can be reached which are a culmination of all the choices you made during the playthrough. There is an achievement for each ending so feel free to replay with different choices to see if you arrive at a different ending.

At this stage I won't reveal exactly how to reach each ending but it's not overly complicated. I will monitor  the statistics though and if people are having difficulties I'll provide some hints. 

For now I will be performing a quality check over the entire game looking for any bugs, typos, graphical glitches, animation improvements, or anything that just doesn't make sense. After that I intend to move the game out of early release into full release.

Thank you to everyone who left reviews, reported bugs, provided feedback, or even just left a comment. It means a lot to me.

Report any bugs you find but otherwise enjoy!

JellyFluff

notes.title: Fourth content update released
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce the release of the fourth content update for Forbidden Dojo.

This update continues the story where it was left off and is about equal in size to the previous update. There are new scenes to view in this release and new locations to discover.

I have made some small changes to improve compatibility with Steam Deck and will be submitting this build for review to hopefully achieve a verified status.

Soon work will start on the fifth update so let me know what you think or if you have any suggestions.

Report any bugs you find but otherwise enjoy!

JellyFluff

notes.title: Third content update released
notes.content:
I am happy to announce the release of the third content update for Forbidden Dojo.

This update continues the story where it was left off though is a little shorter than the first two updates. I wanted to make sure I had enough time to release it before the end of the month for various reasons. There are new scenes to view as well as two new achievements based upon these scenes.

This version fixes a handful of typos that I found in previous updates. There is also now a [b]hide[/b] button on the menu that hides the user interface allowing you to see the entire scene without any text in the way. It was previously able to be hidden via a shortcut key but is now a bit more obvious so people don't have to view the help section to find it.

Soon work will start on the fourth update so let me know what you think or if you have any suggestions.

Report any bugs you find but otherwise enjoy!

JellyFluff

notes.title: Second content update released
notes.content:
I am happy to announce the release of the second content update for Forbidden Dojo.

This update continues the story where it was left off and is about equal in size to the first content update. There are new scenes to view as well as a new achievement based upon these scenes.

Soon work will start on the third update so let me know what you think or if you have any suggestions.

Also I have been asked whether I will be revisiting old content and updating it. The answer to that is yes. While I am currently committed to adding additional content I will eventually go over all the content and update any images/dialogue that need fixing or updating. For the full release I also plan on improving and updating the animations.

Report any bugs you find but otherwise enjoy!

JellyFluff

notes.title: Gallery update
notes.content:
A small update has been released for Forbidden Dojo which implements a scene replay gallery on the main menu. This has previously been requested by the community and I'm happy to be able to announce it has now been implemented.

This will allow players to rewatch certain scenes as well as see if there are any scenes that have been missed. Scenes should automatically unlock once they have been viewed. The gallery should also be applied retroactively - meaning you should already see your unlocked scenes - you won't have to replay the game.

Due to the way the game was initially set up it won't pull your character name from the save files but instead there is an input box on the replay menu which allows you to set the MC name. It should remember this even after quitting the game so you should only have to set it once unless you want to change it.

That's all I have for now. I'll shortly start working on the next content update so feel free to suggest any inclusions. Also I would appreciate if you could leave a review for the game - the more reviews it gets the higher the visibility is on Steam so it would help me out a lot. Thanks.

Please report any bugs you find but otherwise enjoy!

JellyFluff

notes.title: First content update released
notes.content:
I am happy to announce the release of the first content update for Forbidden Dojo.

This update continues the story where it was left off and increases the amount of content compared to the initial release by around 80%. There are new scenes to view and locations to be visited in this version.

The choices are starting to matter a little more now as there are certain scenes that may be locked out depending on the combination of choices you make. 

Soon work will start on the second update so let me know what you think or if you have any suggestions.

Report any bugs you find but otherwise enjoy!

JellyFluff

notes.title: Upcoming update
notes.content:
This is just a little bit of news about the upcoming update.

Most of the work on the update has been completed - there's just a few more images to fix up and some testing to be done. I expect it will be released within the next few days provided everything goes to plan.

The update will continue the story where it was left off. There's going to be a number of new locations to visit and scenes to view. Regarding the amount of content I would estimate it has about 80% additional content which may vary a bit depending on the choices that are chosen during gameplay.

That's all the news I have for now. I will continue to update everyone when there is more information. Thank you.

JellyFluff

notes.title: Post-Launch Update
notes.content:
This is just a small announcement to provide some updates to the community about Forbidden Dojo.

Firstly I'd like to thank everyone who purchased the game. Your support and feedback have been invaluable to me and have contributed to its successful launch. 

I am happy to inform you that progress is already underway on a new update, which will include even more content for you to explore and enjoy. I'm very excited about this update as I'm able to fully focus my attention on enhancing the game itself.

If you've enjoyed what you've seen so far I encourage you to leave a review of the game. Your feedback is crucial in helping me continue to improve the game and provide you with the best possible experience.

Thank you once again for your support, and we look forward to bringing you even more exciting updates in the near future.

JellyFluff
